source_reviews: Vergessen Sie es!, Ich habe es vergessen. and Ich werde dich nie vergessen. remain separate course expressions while linked to the reviewed vergessen lexical family.

erkennen and auseinanderhalten remain separate learner targets; erkennen preserves an + Dativ for identifying features while the recognized object is Akkusativ; the shared-row source mismatch for auseinanderhalten remains provenance-visible and audit-only.
entschuldigen direct-transitive and reflexive uses remain separate; sich bei jdm. entschuldigen records bei + Dativ and sich für etw. entschuldigen records für + Akkusativ.
Sag mal! receives a pragmatic learner-layer Persian rendering while the source's overly literal Persian seed remains preserved in provenance.
in früheren Jahren retains the course target while its inherited mixed German-Persian source example remains audit-only.
lügen and Lügen erzählen remain separate; the inherited example that only demonstrates lügen is not reused as evidence for the collocation.
raten is split into advice and guessing senses; the advice sense records a Dativ addressee and optional zu + Dativ, while a wrong-sense inherited example remains audit-only for the guessing target.
Stimmt!, Hier stimmt etwas nicht! and Da stimmt etwas nicht! remain distinct course redemittel tied to the reviewed correctness/in-order sense.
